recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Handle any future BackboneElement/BackboneType location clarification through FHIR-52858 or a later final work-group decision, not as a FHIR-18352 fixup.
issue_request: FHIR-18352 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core clarification asking to replace confusing text about modifierExtension placement inside extensions with clearer wording that is-modifier elements not defined as part of an extension definition cannot be conveyed.
initial_application: Git commit 1932b2b59558a616c0ca6d62c123b1c92dc6e15f directly applied the issue by changing source/extensibility.html from the old modifierExtension sentence to the requested is-modifier wording.
additional_context: Earlier FHIR-8548 and FHIR-11036 provide the complex-extension background. Later FHIR-37903 added explicit guidance that an extension root isModifier flag determines extension versus modifierExtension placement and added a parenthetical example without reversing the FHIR-18352 rule. Submitted FHIR-52858 and its Zulip thread concern broader guidance about where modifierExtension may appear, but remain unresolved.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/extensibility.html in the current build-scope source already states the corrected rule and its surrounding text remains consistent after later clarifications.
